title: Return Code Buffer on the Credit Builder Accounts AutoPay Due Day
content:
When AutoPay is turned on again on a Credit Builder account, days are added to the account's current due day according to why the account's most recent returned payment came back.

## Return-code buffers

When the account's most recent returned payment carries return code R09 (uncollected funds), the uncollected-funds buffer is added; when it carries R01 (insufficient funds), the funds buffer; for any other code no reason buffer is added; when two payments were returned on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent.

The return code is the one on the returned-payment entry. The most recent returned payment is any returned payment on the account, whatever its date and whatever kind of payment it reversed.

| Return code of the most recent returned payment | Days added to the due day |
|---|---|
| R09 | uncollected-funds buffer: 3 days |
| R01 | funds buffer: 2 days |
| any other code, a chargeback (CB) included | 0 days |
